questions.prompt: Which activity is linked to undersea data cables in the article?
options: Buying something from an online shop.
Moving fishing nets across the seabed.
questions.explanationZh: 第2、3句把国际数据电缆与网购等活动联系起来；第4句区分了天然气管道和输电电缆，渔网则在后文作为故障原因出现。

questions.prompt: What is the role of the twelve-week consultation?
options: To review how the proposed rules are working.
To gather views for the final proposals.
To give providers time to adopt the final rules.
To explain decisions already made about the proposals.
questions.explanationZh: 第6、7句说明意见征询发生在最终方案形成之前，目的是收集各方意见；不是检查已实施规则，也不是给企业执行已定规则的过渡期。

questions.prompt: Under one proposed change, what would cable providers need to do?
options: Publish regular accounts of customers’ use of their networks.
Coordinate public consultations about risks to their networks.
Set the penalties for damage caused to their networks.
Strengthen the identification and management of network risks.
questions.explanationZh: 第8句明确提出加强供应商识别和管理网络风险的义务。征询意见和加重处罚虽在文中出现，但没有说由供应商组织征询或制定处罚；也未要求公布客户使用情况。

questions.prompt: Why does the article mention fishing nets and technical failures?
options: To explain the recent growth in demand for undersea connections.
To explain why the consultation includes views from the public.
To illustrate how cable damage can have causes other than deliberate attacks.
To illustrate the changes that providers would make to protect their networks.
questions.explanationZh: 第11句指出损坏并不一定源于蓄意攻击，第12句列举渔网和技术失灵，正是说明其他故障原因；这些例子不是需求增长、征询参与范围或拟议防护措施的解释。
